product_one_liner.value: Matillion is a data integration platform that helps data teams build and manage data pipelines faster for AI and analytics at scale.

pricing_page.notes: Public page describes three plans and consumption-based credits.

hq_location.notes: Matillion has dual headquarters: Manchester, United Kingdom, and Denver, United States.

eng_blog.notes: Two posts by software engineering interns explain the implementation of a pipeline quality reviewer and an agentic monitoring tool.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes pipeline-building guides, connector references, and API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: AI Data Scientist role in Manchester with an application link.

model_provider.value: AWS Bedrock, OpenAI's ChatGPT, and OpenAI for Azure
model_provider.notes: These third-party AI services are explicitly named in Matillion's AI FAQ.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022 and PCI DSS attestations, and states GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn lists November 8, 2022 as the latest round, classifies it as Series E, and names Databricks as the investor; the amount was undisclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded funding was in November 2022, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Sales Development Representative opening with an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Matillion announced general availability of Maia Foundation on Google BigQuery on July 8, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On August 4, 2026, Matillion announced Girish Pancha as CEO and Sanjay Krishnamurthi as Chief Development Officer.
